name: git-graph-pro
description: Interactive Git graph with full workflow and AI code review

gitGraphPro.aiReview.deepseekApiKey.description: DeepSeek API key for AI code review. Get one at https://platform.deepseek.com

gitGraphPro.aiReview.defaultProvider.description: Default AI provider for code review. 'auto' detects available CLIs.

gitGraphPro.aiReview.defaultModel.description: Default model to use (e.g. 'sonnet', 'gpt-4o', 'deepseek-chat'). Leave empty for provider default.

gitGraphPro.aiReview.timeoutSeconds.description: Stop the review if it produces no output for this many seconds. Measures silence, not total runtime. Default 0 means no timeout: a thorough review of a large change can take a long time, and being cut off mid-answer is worse than waiting.

gitGraphPro.aiReview.maxDiffChars.description: Cap the diff sent for review, in characters. Default 0 sends the complete diff so the reviewer sees the real change. Only set this if a model rejects the request for size; files are then dropped whole (never mid-hunk) and the omitted ones are named in the prompt.

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:webview
scripts.check: npm test && npm run coverage && npm run typecheck && npm run build
